Name: JP's Farms - Infertile Standard Farm - Big Farm Cave
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][center][color=#00ff00][u]﻿Infertile Farm[/u][/color][/center][/size][/i][/b]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][b][i]In this farm the soil is too hard to be worked, let alone to grow anything. The cave will have more prominence as you will be able to grow crops inside![/i][/b][/size][/color]


[list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]In this farm you can't grow crops normally but it can be used to breed animals together with the special grass that grows here.[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]With the exception of cultivation, everything else is functioning normally.[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Now the much larger cave can be used for farming. It doesn't rain inside but you can use sprinklers without problems. [/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Does not interfere with the decision of mushrooms or bats.[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]You can still choose whether you want mushrooms or bats in the cave, everything is prepared for both cases. Marked places for the mushroom boxes, which can be plowed if you choose the bats, and the bats will leave fruit daily.[/size][/color][/font]
[/list][/font][font=Georgia]

[color=#ff0000][size=5][i]With nothing more to add, I hope you enjoy this experiment.
